steps.caption: Open the Lumen Harbour Tech lease from Leases.
In Important dates, each escalation shows its date and the expected new rent: 15% every 36 months on the last paid rent.
Commercial terms: current values next to the original version 1. Unknown terms are simply not listed.
Version 2 was extracted from the deed and is Proposed: it adds the escalation, the term and the lock-in.
Nothing extracted replaces the terms by itself. After checking, press Confirm as current.
Version 2 is now current; version 1 is kept as history.
Financials: rent, CAM, parking and other costs a month. Unknown items say unknown — they are not counted as zero.
The escalation table: each step, its effective date, the expected rent, the actual rent recorded and a check.
Step 1 matches: ₹13.8 lakh was recorded after January 2027. A different amount would show a discrepancy.
Record a payment or actual value adds rent or CAM paid. Payment status comes only from these records.
Record an amendment adds new terms with an effective date — the old terms stay in the history.
